# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_WITH_VOLUME_SPIKE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A gap up >0.3% accompanied by a 5‑min volume spike >2x average and a bearish intra‑gap bar signals a gap fade short. This edge exists because gaps up on high volume often attract late buyers who become trapped when the gap fails, leading to a mean-reversion move as the initial imbalance is corrected.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: IF (open - prev_close)/prev_close > 0.003 AND volume_5min > 2*avg_volume_5min_(premarket OR prior 5‑min) AND close_5min < open_5min THEN enter short at close of that 5‑min bar.  
Exit shape: chart-stop at gap day‑high (highest price since open), TP1 at 1R, runner trail 10% off HWM.  
Regime hint: Effective when VIX >16 (gap‑prone) and only in the first 15 minutes after open; discard if gap >0.8% (extreme).
